concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2/3 vs spec.md:SC-003, US-3 Independent Test
concerns.text: SC-003 and US-3 require a PDF report ('parcel-wise association map and PDF report'; data-model lists reports/link_entropy_risk.pdf). No task produces a PDF: T012 produces figures/NIfTI only, T013/T014 produce markdown. If the PDF is deferred to the paper stage, a task must state that handoff explicitly; currently the deliverable has no covering task.

The active QC contract requires per-subject fields `selected` (boolean) and `reason` (string) as REQUIRED. T003's output description ('clean_subjects.parquet (valid cohort, status="valid") and subject_qc.csv') never states these fields are populated, so outputs cannot conform to the schema as written.

Active contracts require fields tied to a nonexistent FR-009: `includes_noise_variance`, `resampling_correlation`, `ks_pvalue` (entropy metadata, required) and `vif`, `partial_corr_entropy_dsrt` (per-parcel, required). No task computes noise variance, 2mm-vs-4mm resampling correlation, KS comparison, or partial correlations, so T005/T007 outputs cannot conform. Either tasks must cover these fields or the contracts must be revised — currently there is a coverage gap.

FR-008/SC-004 require sweeping 'scale parameter m over a set of discrete magnitudes' (SC-004: 'm ∈ {small, moderate, large}'), but T011 sweeps the scale-averaging set τ with embedding dimension m fixed at 2. No task sweeps m as the spec defines it; the tasks and spec disagree on what parameter is covered.

Constitution VI mandates a robustness re-analysis restricted to low-motion participants (mean FD < 0.2 mm). Since FR-002 already excludes FD ≥ 0.2 mm, the primary cohort IS the low-motion subset; no task performs any distinct motion-robustness check (e.g., a stricter FD threshold re-run), so the constitutional requirement has no covering task.

Data-model places results under `results/` and `reports/link_entropy_risk.pdf`, while tasks write to `data/results/`, `figures/`, `reports/results_summary.md`. The path vocabulary diverges from the plan's data model; tasks should state which is authoritative to avoid contract-validation failures.
